headword: {災害対策|さいがいたいさく}

definitions.explanation: Measures and plans put in place to prepare for, respond to, or recover from natural or man-made disasters. A vital concept in disaster-prone Japan.

examples.japanese: {災害対策|さいがいたいさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{災害対策|さいがいたいさく}⟦マニュアル→マニュアル：26993_manyuaru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}した→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧。
examples.english: The city created a new disaster preparedness manual.

examples.english: In earthquake-prone regions, routine disaster preparedness can save lives.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧ (disaster) and ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ (countermeasures). Covers a wide range of activities including evacuation planning, supply stockpiling, infrastructure reinforcement, and public awareness campaigns. Frequently seen in government communications and news reporting.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan experiences frequent earthquakes, typhoons, flooding, and volcanic activity. {災害対策|さいがいたいさく} is a core concept in Japanese public administration. Most municipalities maintain {災害対策|さいがいたいさく}⟦{本部|ほんぶ}→本部：00112_honbu⟧ (disaster response headquarters) that are activated during emergencies.
